subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): onModelDiagnosticEvent for trusted model.* events

question: Should OpenClaw accept `onModelDiagnosticEvent` as a public observability-focused plugin SDK seam for trusted model diagnostics, or defer this need to a provider-scoped model usage API?
rationale: The code blocker is mechanical, but adding a public SDK event stream for trusted model telemetry creates a compatibility and security-boundary contract that automation should not accept on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Accept the narrow diagnostic seam
options.body: Proceed after the SDK surface budgets are updated, keeping the API scoped to observability/cost attribution and the five allowlisted model diagnostic event types.

options.title: Defer to provider-scoped usage
options.body: Pause or close this PR and revive a provider-owned model usage feed if maintainers want accounting consumers to avoid diagnostics entirely.

options.title: Request a different SDK contract
options.body: Keep the problem open but ask for different naming, event shape, attribution, or trust semantics before adding a public export.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow diagnostic seam
recommendation.body: Proceed after the SDK surface budgets are updated, keeping the API scoped to observability/cost attribution and the five allowlisted model diagnostic event types.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership covers the diagnostic event and plugin SDK surface guard paths, and prior diagnostics hook work makes this the best available routing candidate.
